note_on_tokens: Duck.ai / DuckDuckGo chat uses ephemeral, short-lived anti-abuse challenge headers (x-vqd-*) that are generated per session. They were NOT extracted from the live browser session in this capture, and they expire / rotate, so they cannot be reused as a stable API key.

request_headers: x-vqd-hash-1: <hash generated from the status challenge>

phase1_html.note: Frontend sets __DDG_BE_VERSION__/__DDG_FE_CHAT_HASH__ from these <html> attributes (found in entry JS bundle)

phase2_status.x_vqd_hash_1: base64 JS challenge, ~5408 chars header / ~4-4.8KB decoded, executes in JSDOM and returns {server_hashes(3), client_hashes(3), signals, meta{v:4, challenge_id, timestamp}} - VALUES NOT STORED (single-use, ephemeral)

phase3_chat_test.note: Server rejected the Phase-2 hash alone; current frontend also sends x-fe-signals and extra token headers. Not retried repeatedly to avoid hammering the service.

phase3_reverse_engineering_2026-10-20.source: duck.ai entry JS bundle scraped and analyzed (entry.duckai.*.js)
phase3_reverse_engineering_2026-10-20.chat_url: POST https://duck.ai/duckchat/v1/chat (DUCKCHAT_API='/duckchat/v1' relative to duck.ai origin — NOT duckduckgo.com)

headers_resolved.x-fe-signals: btoa(JSON({start, events:[{name,delta}], end})) — fraud-signal summary, dc_ prefix stripped
headers_resolved.x-duckai-bypass-fixed-cost-windows: optional, only when a usage-limit bypass is stored — omitted
headers_resolved.x-duckai-bonus-id: optional, only with a bonus id — omitted

phase3_reverse_engineering_2026-10-20.solver_transform: run challenge JS -> take result -> client_hashes = base64(SHA-256(each client_hash)) -> meta += {origin: 'https://duck.ai', stack, duration} -> btoa(JSON.stringify(result))
phase3_reverse_engineering_2026-10-20.vm_egress_block: Control tests on the Muse sandbox VM: POST https://example.com/ timed out (20s), POST https://duck.ai/duckchat/v1/status timed out, while GETs respond in ~1s and POST https://duckduckgo.com/duckchat/v1/chat returns 418 in ~6s. So a live chat POST to duck.ai cannot be completed from this VM — its egress proxy holds most POSTs. The API must be run on a normal network to complete Phase 3.
